dialog.protect.note: printcraft dialogs/protect.rs: Viewing needs an open password; Editing sets a permissions password and the limits (printing, changes, copying, screen readers). Advanced Options holds the compatibility level and what to encrypt. Office-only 'Only file attachments' is not in printcraft and is not shown. The limits show for Editing (printcraft shows them under Advanced Options); the metadata choice is refused for the RC4 levels. The Apply button is labelled Protect: a spec button named Apply keeps its dialog open, and printcraft's Apply closes it.

fields.label: Requires user to enter a password for:
Changes allowed
options: Filling in form fields and signing existing signature fields
Commenting, filling in form fields, and signing existing signature fields

dialog.security-properties.title: Security Properties
dialog.security-properties.note: Document Properties > Security (printcraft PropsTab::Security): the method and what the permissions allow. Read only; Protect and Remove security change it.

prompt.password.note: printcraft dialogs/prompts.rs:351. A wrong password keeps the dialog open with the message; the password is a secret param and is never stored or logged.

prompt.permissions-password.note: printcraft dialogs/prompts.rs:366 (request_unlock). Only the permissions (owner) password lifts the limits: the open password is refused.

protect.remove.note: Removes at once when the document is unrestricted; a restricted one asks for the permissions password first (commands.rs:199).

alltools.protect.encrypt-with-certificat.note: Hidden: printcraft lists Encrypt with certificate as planned:M8 with no command, so it is not translated.
